title: Ensure multi-factor authentication is enforced for the organization
description: Not observable from Bitbucket Data Center: authentication is delegated to an external identity provider, and Bitbucket's API exposes nothing about factors. Reported as MANUAL because a verdict from Bitbucket data alone would be invented.
remediation: Enforce MFA at the identity provider that fronts Bitbucket: require it for the SAML/OIDC application in your IdP, or enable two-step verification in Crowd. Then close the bypass paths — Administration -> Authentication: disable direct Bitbucket login where SSO is mandatory, and require SSH keys or HTTP access tokens for Git operations so passwords cannot be used to skip the IdP.
remediationZh: 在 Bitbucket 前置的身份提供方处强制 MFA：在 IdP 中对该 SAML/OIDC 应用启用强制多因子，或在 Crowd 中开启两步验证。随后封堵旁路——管理后台 -> Authentication：在强制 SSO 的场景下禁用 Bitbucket 本地登录；并要求 Git 操作使用 SSH key 或 HTTP access token，避免用密码绕过 IdP。
